caseName: Householder v. Ohio A. Philip Randolph Inst.
caseNameFull: Larry HOUSEHOLDER, applicants v. OHIO A. PHILIP RANDOLPH INSTITUTE

opinions.text: Application for stay presented to Justice SOTOMAYOR and by her referred to the Court is granted, and it is ordered that the order of the United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio, case No. 1:18-CV-00357, entered May 3, 2019, is stayed pending the timely filing and disposition of an appeal in this Court or further order of this Court.
